invariants.rule: Implementation review must not use changed-layer count to skip a declared acceptance path.
invariants.positive_case: A DTO-only diff is reviewed through the final UI state and Integration evidence.
invariants.negative_case: The reviewer stops after the DTO unit test because no UI file changed.

invariants.rule: Writer and reviewer must not accept a check that remains green on the known-bad implementation.
invariants.positive_case: The legacy field-loss fixture fails before the repair and passes after it.
invariants.negative_case: Only a post-fix helper happy path is asserted.

invariants.rule: The semantic reviewer must not rewrite Requirements, Overview, or Detail when runtime evidence contradicts them.
invariants.positive_case: The reviewer returns the earliest owning defect class and bounded repair route.
invariants.negative_case: The reviewer edits the product outcome to match the current implementation.

invariants.rule: Writer, reviewer, and Integration consume CH-01's exact dual-snapshot AcceptanceResolution without private projection and produce no current receipt when missing/stale after append/register/baseline change, field-incomplete, snapshot-mismatched, or either blocker set is open.
invariants.positive_case: The current result carries baseline, both snapshot refs and blocker sets, rows/refs/task/IDs/probe; both blockers are empty and every consumer uses it unchanged.
invariants.negative_case: An identity-unreadable global debt or append after resolution is hidden by an acceptance-ID-filtered read, old ledger prefix, or private projection, and a later pass causes writer or reviewer to report green.
test_evidence: unreadable-debt plus later-pass writer/reviewer false-green scenario

invariants.rule: Ordinary slice receipts must not replace final Integration or runtime acceptance.
invariants.positive_case: Integration closes the final union snapshot and hands off required runtime probes.
invariants.negative_case: Four ordinary green receipts are reported as accepted.
